description: Save DRAFT ONLY a materials section using separate administrative save authorization. Read online_material_sections_get first. Supply lowercase ASCII slug (max80), current expected_version, section_revision from existing section or empty string for a NEW unused slug, unique request_id (1-64 letters/digits/._:-), and payload EXACTLY {title:{ru,en},description:{ru,en},article_ids:[existing integer IDs]}. Both localized titles are required plain text max64, descriptions plain text max1000, at most1000 distinct article IDs. Does not create/change a public tag, change any article, or publish other content. Returns version and saved draft_revision. Identical retry must reuse every argument/ID; changed arguments conflict; ambiguous pending operations require reconciliation.
name: online_material_section_save
